method.cagr: Ordinary least squares of ln(value) on calendar year over the used years, slope b. CAGR = exp(b) - 1. A CAGR needs at least 2 used years; the 95% interval needs at least 3. Interval = exp(b -/+ t * SE(b)) - 1, with SE(b) from the residual scatter and t the two-sided 95% Student t quantile at df = n - 2.
method.index: index = value / value in window.base_year (value is a count or a share).
method.retractions: C and D: counts exclude retracted-flagged records (count = records minus retracted). A and B: the OpenAlex group_by cannot split retractions, so counts include them. Shares use both sides with retracted-flagged records included (the unit of A), so C/A stays like for like. No share uses a retraction-excluded count.
method.shares: The share trend is the same fit on ln(share), so it is the growth of the numerator relative to the denominator.
method.uncertainty: The CI reflects year-to-year scatter around a log-linear trend, not sampling error.
method.unit: Series A, B and C: OpenAlex records by publication year (duplicates not collapsed). Series D: curated works, one row per work. A ratio is taken only between the pairs listed in ratio_pairs, which share a counting unit and a type sensitivity. D is shown beside them and is never divided.
method.window: Complete years only, from window.start to window.end (last_complete_year). The as-of year and later are excluded and listed in partial_years_excluded. window.start is the requested start, or the first year in the series when that is later.
method.zero_counts: A zero count is skipped in the log-linear fit (ln 0 is undefined) and listed in zero_years_skipped. n_years counts the years used. A zero share (zero numerator) is skipped the same way, and a year with a zero denominator has no share.

what_this_is_and_is_not.is: Counts of OpenAlex records by publication year. Each record is one OpenAlex work ID, and duplicate records are not merged. A is every record that matches the plastics search query. C is the part of those matching records that has an author at a California institution, so C/A is the California share of matching records. B is a narrower set that also matches the pollution-core terms, so B/A is the pollution-core share of matching records.
what_this_is_and_is_not.is_not: It is not a share of all plastics research, and it is not a Web of Science total. The published plastic-related works (D) are curated works, so they are shown beside the counts and never divided. Retracted-flagged records stay in the all-types counts, because OpenAlex cannot separate them there.
